The function signature says optional_param?: boolean, default false. So we can pass optional_param: false.

We need to call both functions. According to guidelines, we should call them sequentially. The user wants both pieces of info. We can call criminal_record_get_status first with criminal_name: "John Doe", region: "New York". Then call criminal_record_get_offense_nature with criminal_name: "John Doe", optional_param: false.

We need to output the calls as JSON objects. The assistant should produce two separate calls. The guidelines say we should not combine them into one call. So we will produce two calls.
